description: Someone breathes in just behind your ear. Their next breath comes from inside your chest.
A bell rings under your feet, muffled by packed earth. The air smells of freshly turned soil.
Wet wood crackles beside you, and the air smells of cold ash. For a heartbeat, embers glow beneath your fingernails.
Footsteps start at your heels and recede into the distance. With each step, the sound of your own breathing grows fainter.
